schema.description: Recycled Action Plan Test Record Requests (Index)

items.description: Recycled Action Plan Test Record Request (Show)

id.description: Unique identifier of the test record request.

plan_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the Action Plan Item this test record request belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the test record request was created. ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the test record request was moved to the recycle bin. ISO 8601 format.

payload.description: Contains specific attributes depending on the type of Action Plan Test Record Request

checklist_template_id.description: Identifier of the linked checklist template. Present when type is 'checklist'.

form_template_id.description: Identifier of the linked form template. Present when type is 'form'.

generic_tool_id.description: Identifier of the linked generic tool. Present when type is 'generic_tool'.

plan_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent Action Plan.

plan_test_records_count.description: Count of Action Plan Test Records linked to this Action Plan Test Record Request

type.description: Categorization of the test record request. Determines which payload fields are populated.

type_id.description: Identifier of the test record type lookup record.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the test record request was last modified. ISO 8601 format.
